# Odoo Modules

This site contains a list of open-source modules available for Odoo.

## JSON Data

You can download either a small JSON file with a summary of all modules (then download data about individual modules separately), or download a JSON file containing all data:

- The smaller index: https://odoomodules.com/modules.json (~1.1 MB)
  Schema: https://odoomodules.com/schemas/modules.json
  Follow the "item" link to get details for an individual module.

- All data in one file: https://odoomodules.com/modules-full.json (~8.6 MB)
  Schema: https://odoomodules.com/schemas/modules-full.json
